disposition: Readable-source review complete for recorded scope. Scoped native-AA relocation and same-group warning allocation plus experimental default-off point-defence code are now integrated; see current sections and shared AEGIS mechanism review. Physical firing/interception, balance/performance and broader unsupported ownership/weapon layers remain unproven or incomplete. Aircraft evasion is not ground-AA parity.

nativeShotObservation.finding: Existing ArtilleryShellFired mission listener serves artillery; ordinary AA gunnery has no qualified native-shot record usable by relocation. Vehicle target assignment is not proof of a shot.
nativeShotObservation.implementation: CortexAAObserve installs versioned local Fired listener only for eligible native editor-role AA vehicles through existing16vehicle discovery slice. Actual local AI gunner, projectile, current feature/owner/task checks; coalesced1s real-shot receipt contains group/epoch/time/station ammo/self-position, no hostile transform or reveal. Discovery locality/feature loss and pre-client-exit shutdown remove listener/receipt.
nativeShotObservation.nextRequired: Consume exact epoch/current-order shot episode through existing group operation/FSM for finite relocation after engagement; CortexVehicles currently exits before air query on empty contact and GroupTick targetless safety call is not general relocation. No movement should be appended to observer.
nativeShotObservation.featureCredit: Observation foundation only, no AA relocation/interception completion.

implementation: Actual AA shot receipt now retains original native route and recent personally known assigned air-contact belief/time. Other qualified fire updates quiet-time clock without erasing the air episode.

CortexGroupTick services active AA operation before contact-off return; admission follows authored task classification. One original shot+120s episode, one five-candidate terrain attempt after8s fire quiet, throttled5s native-air checks.

Eligible independent idle native-AA mobile crew group only, no authored route replacement. Close fresh ground threats, current assigned native threats, mixed foot/vehicle groups, convoy/external ownership, unavailable seats and role reservations refuse.

Native HOLD operation and movement lease use existing group FSM; arrival physically observed; order/owner/epoch change, new threat/fire, feature closure and expiry retire matching generation. Existing Contact/Vehicles/Gunnery/Standoff gates.
No new timer, reveal, radar override, free smoke, physics recovery, interception or permanent controller. Uninvolved discovery vehicles avoid nil/registry writes.
limits: AA custom editor-role classification, mixed/multi-vehicle groups and authored-route continuation are not covered by this scoped implementation.
Ground anti-munition interception and layered AA allocation remain unimplemented.
Actual movement, cancellation/repeat/locality handback, tactical balance and 5%median/10%p95 budget remain physically unverified; audits paused.

No persistent weapon-capability cache. Dedicated native AA retains aircraft priority; other platforms keep AT infantry/armour first and do not acquire AA relocation roles.
customCategoryAirGunnery.costAndBalance: <=2 additional unlabelled platform attempts per group callback; deterministic rotating slots cover every unchanged roster in ceil(n/2) callbacks, including wasted ineligible slots. At most one shared AIR native knowledge pass per group callback. Existing32-query station cap, same-frame failed scan reuse and final fresh readiness remain. customCategoryAirGunnery.limits: Air-capable ammunition/config is not native lock, firing/hit or interception proof. No ground anti-munition/layered allocation or dedicated custom-AA movement implementation. Physical normal/HC performance pending; audits paused.

nativeWarningThreatPriority.behaviour: Existing gunnery can rank warning firer above other aircraft only when owner/group/epoch/finite expiry match and the actual gunner independently has a fresh<=3s personally known nonignored hostile aircraft row. No warning-only contact insertion, hidden source geometry, target reveal, radar/ROE/movement changes or new fire controller. Existing target hold and fresh loaded station/muzzle/lane gates remain.
nativeWarningThreatPriority.sourceIntent: Select useful incoming-threat priority from Protocol/AEGIS intent. This is recent-attacker prioritisation through native gunnery, not a substitute or completion claim for ground anti-munition interception/layered defence.

dedicatedRole20261028.finding: Six CBE consumers/seven sites used editorSubcategory alone for dedicated-AA role. Generic rotating custom-air gunnery already exists; it did not grant custom-category dedicated observation/allocation/interception/relocation role or consistent armour-shot exclusion. Do not count generic-air capability again.
dedicatedRole20261028.sourceIntent: Protocol _isAA requires live LandVehicle, then accepts AA_IsAirDefense explicit object marker or EdSubcat_AAs editor category. Explicit role intent is useful; CBE does not import the source marker, global loops, radar override or projectile destruction.
implementation: One pure CortexAirDefenceRole shared by AA observer, allocator, interceptor admission, relocation, gunnery priority/allocation and armour-shot admission. Existing native AA category remains accepted.

A custom-category LandVehicle gains the role hint only when the native three-entry threat profile is finite/nonnegative and positive air weight strictly exceeds both soft and armour. Mixed/equal/default ground profiles stay ordinary. This is CBE policy interpreting native config intent, not an engine-certified role or weapon-capability test.
At most256 immutable class results memoised locally. Overflow computes without storing. No live loaded-magazine/native-task/permission cache, world scan, new event/worker or state publication.

Actual loaded weapon station, target/contact, crew locality, ROE, original task/lease and movement/physics gates remain in existing owners. Default-off interception remains off. A class role alone grants no fire, relocation or warning identity.

Existing generic custom-air gunnery rotation is retained; air-dominant platforms now take the dedicated role consistently instead of only that fallback. No source-specific compatibility layer or classname substring guessing.

engineReference.fact: Native threat[] weights describe soft, armour and air targets and contribute to target selection. CBE air-dominance classification is an inference/policy, not an engine guarantee of ammunition/lock suitability.

dedicatedRole20261028.cost: Fixed native config reads once per retained class, max256entries. Existing calls replace repeated category reads; newly qualified custom classes can install existing AA observers or reach existing allocation/relocation paths. Their workload and native capability quality remain unmeasured.
remaining: Misauthored threat vectors, ambiguous mixed-role platforms, source-style explicit role declarations and all custom AA categories are not solved universally. No whole-mod/source parity claim.
Physical custom station/relocation/gunnery/intercept behaviour, mixed-role balance, normal/HC transfer, false category/profile classification and median/p95 cost remain unverified; audits paused.
Broader point-defence weapon layers, projectile ownership/effects, guided/payload support and required provider handovers remain open.
